series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, muted earth/stone/bronze midtones, deep ink-navy shadows)

scenes.shot_type: Frozen Bone-Mountain Foothills & Solitary Watchtower Beacon in Long Night (24mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm low-angle ultra-wide: snow-buried Bronze-Age watchtowers & ice-locked river terraces below Bone Mountains under crushing ink-navy storm night & lone amber beacon

scenes.shot_type: Bronze-Gauntleted Hands Igniting the Forged Blade of Living Fire (85mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm macro-telephoto detail: weathered leather-and-verdigris-bronze gauntleted hands gripping oxidized hilt as living orange-gold fire roars up forged blade in snowstorm

scenes.shot_type: Close-Up Portrait of Azor Ahai / Eastern Champion With Blazing Sword in Blizzard (85mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm portrait close-up: frost-rimmed eastern Bronze-Age champion in wolf-fur & oxidized bronze collar lit by blazing sword of living fire against winter storm

scenes.shot_type: Torchlit Triptych of Three Ancient Eastern Hero Reliefs With Gold-Leaf Swords (100mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm archaeological relief detail: three wordless cliff-cut stone bas-reliefs depicting Hyrkoon the Hero, Yin Tar & eastern steppe champion with gold-leaf blades

scenes.shot_type: Flame-Sword Champion Splitting Long Night Clouds Above Hyrkoon Pass (40mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm epic mountain wide: lone champion atop bone-strewn crag between Hyrkoon cliff-bastions raising blazing sword as warm sandstone dawn pierces ink-navy storm

scenes.shot_type: Prehistoric Spiral-Carved Standing Stones Overlooking Sunlit Essosi River Dawn (28mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm low-angle bluff wide: shadowed moss-grown spiral monoliths overlooking sunlit misty river valley & awakening terraced Bronze-Age hamlets

scenes.shot_type: Ancient Bearded Chronicler Tracing Wordless Essosi River Map in Sandstone Loggia (40mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm riverside archive medium-wide: silver-bearded ancient historian tracing quill over wordless river-and-mountain vellum map weighted by bronze astrolabe rings

scenes.shot_type: Snowmelt Waterfalls & Broad Thawing Upper River Rhoyne Under Receding Storm (28mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm cliff-edge landscape wide: snowmelt waterfalls cascading down sandstone bluffs into silver-jade River Rhoyne & rose-sandstone hamlets as winter storm retreats

scenes.shot_type: Sun-Drenched Springtime Orchard & Barley Terraces Along the Mother Rhoyne (24mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm orchard-terrace ultra-wide: golden spring sunlight bathing irrigated green terraces & Bronze-Age farmers along the shimmering silver-green Mother Rhoyne

scenes.shot_type: Early Rhoynar Rose-Sandstone River Quay, Artisans & Gilded Skiffs (50mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm riverside quay medium-wide: early Rhoynar artisans & traders unloading bronze vessels & amphorae beside gilded wooden skiffs & basking giant river turtle
